title: Approval and callback page handlers that products mount
description: Owner: Cyclotron session. broker/pages.py: framework-neutral handlers for /cli/approve (describe, show requester, matching code, target and privileges, ask the person to compare the code, CSRF-checked Approve that binds sha256(N) and redirects to /oauth2/authorize; Deny) and /cli/callback (check N against the cookie, invoke complete). Adapters for the products' web stacks are the products' own work (Papyrus Next.js, Cyclotron FastAPI).
